subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Accessibility on Mobile
description: A quick win: understand Accessibility on Mobile.

hook.text: A blind user opens your app with VoiceOver. Every button says 'button.' None describe their purpose.

buildup.text: Mobile accessibility means supporting screen readers, dynamic text sizes, and alternative input methods.

discovery.text: Testing with VoiceOver on iOS and TalkBack on Android reveals missing labels and broken navigation order.

twist.text: Increasing system font size to maximum often breaks layouts. Text overflows containers and becomes unreadable.

climax.text: Adding accessibility labels and testing with screen readers makes the app usable for all users.

punchline.text: If a screen reader can't use your app, you've excluded millions.

quiz.question: What does mobile accessibility testing verify?
options: Screen reader support, dynamic text sizes, and alternative inputs
